summary: Meridian Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the mutually agreed resignation of CFO Rich Christensen, effective July 31, 2026, with a separation agreement involving $30,000 severance, unused PTO reimbursement, and transition consulting. The departure is not due to disagreement. The company explicitly terminated his employment agreement without material early termination penalties. The filing also covers restrictive covenants and handover of banking and Nasdaq credentials. What to watch: whether successor CFO is announced and any impact on NASDAQ listing compliance.
